original_title: Remedy didn’t learn anything from its past releases and wants to put Control Resonant next to GTA 6
summary_en: Remedy Entertainment's CEO is unfazed by the prospect of launching its upcoming game, **Control Resonant**, around the same time as the highly anticipated **Grand Theft Auto 6**. He believes the massive attention will ultimately benefit the entire gaming industry.
ai_analysis: This bold strategy from Remedy, often known for its narrative-driven experiences, contrasts sharply with the industry's typical caution around Rockstar's release windows, hinting at a confidence in their long-term vision for **Control Resonant**.

en.title: Remedy CEO Bets Big on Control Resonant Launching Near GTA 6
en.summary: Remedy Entertainment's CEO is unfazed by the prospect of launching its upcoming game, **Control Resonant**, around the same time as the highly anticipated **Grand Theft Auto 6**. He believes the massive attention will ultimately benefit the entire gaming industry.
en.body:
The gaming landscape is a minefield of release dates, where timing can be just as crucial as the game itself. For years, a cardinal rule has been to avoid direct competition with **Rockstar Games**, a titan whose releases often dominate the market for extended periods. However, **Remedy Entertainment**, the studio behind critically acclaimed titles like **Control** and **Alan Wake**, appears to be charting a different course.

Remedy's CEO, **Jean-Charles Gaudechon**, has expressed a surprising lack of concern regarding the potential overlap between their upcoming title, **Control Resonant**, and the monumental launch of **Grand Theft Auto 6**. While many developers would steer clear of such a crowded release window, Gaudechon views it as an opportunity. He suggests that the immense spotlight **GTA 6** will cast on gaming will "raise the tide" for all titles, rather than sink them. This perspective suggests a focus on longevity over immediate sales impact, a "long game" approach that prioritizes sustained interest and player engagement.

> "it's less about trying to make your money back in a few days" — Jean-Charles Gaudechon

This strategy echoes a past decision when the original **Alan Wake** launched on the same day as **Red Dead Redemption** in 2010. While that move was arguably less calculated and more a product of a smaller studio's constraints, the current situation with **Control Resonant** and **GTA 6** feels like a deliberate, albeit high-stakes, gamble. **Remedy** is banking on the idea that the sheer volume of players drawn to consoles by **GTA 6** will create a larger overall audience pool for other games released in close proximity. The studio is known for its visually stunning and narratively rich games, and the hope is that **Control Resonant** will be compelling enough to capture attention even amidst the **Rockstar** frenzy.

## A Calculated Risk or a Risky Bet?

The gaming community is certainly watching this unfolding situation with keen interest. The sheer magnitude of **GTA 6** is unprecedented, and its release is expected to be a cultural event in itself. For **Remedy** to position **Control Resonant** so close to it, with a 2026 release window, is a bold statement. It implies a deep well of confidence in their product and a belief that the rising tide of gaming interest will lift all boats. However, the industry has also seen numerous examples of games struggling to find their footing when launching too close to a major competitor, regardless of their quality. The question remains whether **Remedy**'s faith in the "long game" will pay off or if they've underestimated the gravitational pull of **Rockstar's** behemoth.

## What Lies Ahead for Control Resonant

With **Control Resonant** slated for a 2026 release, details are still emerging. While a specific date has not been confirmed, its positioning within the year, potentially close to **GTA 6**, is a significant talking point. Fans will be eager to see how **Remedy**'s unique gameplay and storytelling will stand out in what is shaping up to be an incredibly competitive period for video game releases.

tr.title: Remedy CEO Büyük Bahiste: Control Resonant'tan GTA 6'ya
tr.summary: Remedy Entertainment'in CEO'su, Control Resonant'ın büyük bir rekabetle aynı zamanda piyasaya sürüleceğini, ancak büyük ilgi, oyun endüstrisinin tümüne yarayacak demekte ısrar ediyor.
tr.body:
Gaming sektöründe, oyunların piyasaya sürülme tarihleri bir maden ocağı gibi görünüyor. Oyunun kendisi kadar önemli olan bir zamanlama vardır. Yıllarca, Rockstar Games'in büyük oyunları piyasaya sürüldüğünde, diğer oyunların önüne geçmek için kaçınılması gereken bir kural olarak kabul edildi. Ancak, kritik olarak kabul edilen oyunlar olan Control ve Alan Wake'in yapımcısı Remedy Entertainment, bu kuralı çiğneyen bir yol izliyor gibi görünüyor.

Remedy Entertainment'in CEO'su Jean-Charles Gaudechon, Control Resonant'ın büyük bir rekabetle aynı zamanda piyasaya sürüleceğini, ancak büyük ilgi, oyun endüstrisinin tümüne yarayacak demekte ısrar ediyor. Bu, birçok geliştiricinin kaçınmak istediği bir durum gibi görünse de, Gaudechon, büyük oyunun gölgesinde kalmak yerine, tüm oyunlar için bir fırsata dönüştüğünü düşünüyor. Bu perspektif, uzun vadeli satışların değil, uzun vadeli ilgi ve oyuncuların katılımını ön planda tutan bir "uzun oyun" yaklaşımını gösteriyor.

"Para kazanmak için birkaç günde değil, bu kadar önemli" — Jean-Charles Gaudechon

Bu strateji, Remedy Entertainment'in kendi oyunu Alan Wake'in 2010'da Red Dead Redemption ile aynı gün piyasaya sürülmesi gibi bir durumla ilgilidir. Bu durum, daha küçük bir stüdyonun kısıtlamaları nedeniyle daha az hesaplı bir karar olarak kabul edilebilir. Ancak, Control Resonant'ın ve GTA 6'nın birlikte piyasaya sürülmesi, daha büyük bir risk ve daha büyük bir ödül anlamına geliyor. Remedy Entertainment, oyun endüstrisinin büyüyen bir kitleye sahip olacağını umuyor ve Control Resonant'ın da bu kitleyi çekmek için yeterince çekici olacağını umuyor.

## Riskli Bir Bahis mi, Hesaplı Bir Karar mı?

Gaming topluluğu, bu gelişmeleri heyecanla izliyor. GTA 6'nın büyüklüğü, bir kültürel olay olarak bekleniyor. Remedy Entertainment'in, Control Resonant'ı bu büyük oyunun gölgesinde piyasaya sürmeyi planlaması, bir cesaretli hamle olarak görülüyor. Bu, stüdyonun güveni ve oyunun kalitesine inanması anlamına geliyor. Ancak, oyun endüstrisinde, büyük bir rakiple aynı zamanda piyasaya sürülen oyunların, büyük rakibin gölgesinde kalmak riski de var.

## Control Resonant'ın Geleceği Hakkında

Control Resonant'ın 2026'da piyasaya sürüleceği planlanıyor. Ancak, oyunun tam bir tarihi henüz belli değil. Oyunun, büyük bir rekabetle aynı zamanda piyasaya sürüleceği planlanması, büyük bir ilginin merkezinde olacak gibi görünüyor. Oyuncular, Remedy Entertainment'in benzersiz oyun oynaması ve hikaye anlatımı ile nasıl öne çıkabileceğini görmek için heyecanla bekliyor.

es.title: Remedy CEO Apuesta Grande en el Lanzamiento de Control Resonante
es.summary: El CEO de Remedy Entertainment no está preocupado por lanzar su próximo juego, Control Resonante, cerca del esperado Grand Theft Auto 6. Cree que la gran atención beneficiará a toda la industria del entretenimiento.
es.body:
El paisaje del entretenimiento es un campo minado de fechas de lanzamiento, donde el momento puede ser tan crucial como el juego en sí. Por años, una regla cardinal ha sido evitar la competencia directa con Rockstar Games, una gigante cuyos lanzamientos a menudo dominan el mercado durante períodos prolongados. Sin embargo, Remedy Entertainment, el estudio detrás de títulos aclamados como Control y Alan Wake, parece estar trazando un curso diferente.

El CEO de Remedy, Jean-Charles Gaudechon, ha expresado una falta sorprendente de preocupación por el potencial solapamiento entre su próximo título, Control Resonante, y el monumental lanzamiento de Grand Theft Auto 6. Si bien muchos desarrolladores se alejarían de una ventana de lanzamiento tan concurrida, Gaudechon ve en ello una oportunidad. Sugiere que la gran luz que Grand Theft Auto 6 proyectará sobre el entretenimiento elevará el nivel para todos los títulos, en lugar de hundirlos. Esta perspectiva sugiere un enfoque en la longevidad sobre el impacto inmediato de las ventas, un enfoque a largo plazo que prioriza el interés sostenido y la participación del jugador.

"Es menos sobre intentar recuperar tu dinero en unos pocos días", dijo Jean-Charles Gaudechon.

Esta estrategia recuerda una decisión pasada cuando el original Alan Wake se lanzó el mismo día que Red Dead Redemption en 2010. Si bien esa decisión fue posiblemente menos calculada y más un producto de las limitaciones de un estudio más pequeño, la situación actual con Control Resonante y Grand Theft Auto 6 parece ser una apuesta deliberada, aunque de alto riesgo. Remedy está apostando a que el volumen de jugadores atraídos a las consolas por Grand Theft Auto 6 creará una piscina de audiencia más grande para otros juegos lanzados en proximidad. El estudio es conocido por sus juegos visualmente impresionantes y narrativamente ricos, y la esperanza es que Control Resonante sea lo suficientemente atractivo como para captar la atención incluso en medio de la locura de Rockstar.

## ¿Un Riesgo Calculado o una Apuesta Arriesgada?

La comunidad de juegos está observando esta situación en desarrollo con gran interés. La magnitud de Grand Theft Auto 6 es sin precedentes, y su lanzamiento se espera que sea un evento cultural en sí mismo. Para Remedy, posicionar Control Resonante tan cerca de él, con un lanzamiento programado para 2026, es un gesto audaz. Implica una profunda confianza en su producto y la creencia de que la marea creciente de interés en los juegos elevará a todos los barcos. Sin embargo, la industria también ha visto numerosos ejemplos de juegos que luchan por encontrar su pie cuando se lanzan demasiado cerca de un competidor importante, independientemente de su calidad. La pregunta sigue siendo si la fe de Remedy en el 'juego largo' se recompensará o si han subestimado la atracción gravitatoria de la gigante de Rockstar.

## ¿Qué Espera a Control Resonante?

Con Control Resonante programado para su lanzamiento en 2026, los detalles están aún emergiendo. Si bien una fecha específica no se ha confirmado, su posición dentro del año, potencialmente cerca de Grand Theft Auto 6, es un punto de discusión significativo. Los fanáticos estarán ansiosos por ver cómo el juego único de Remedy y su narrativa se destacarán en lo que está resultando ser un período muy competitivo para los lanzamientos de videojuegos.

content_raw: In video games, anything goes. Really, this industry is much different than many other, more traditional ones. But there is one rule all must follow, or else you risk missing out on a lot of money or potentially killing your entire franchise: never compete with Rockstar. But Remedy never got the memo and just kept doing it anyway. Back in 2010, the first Alan Wake came out on exactly the same day as Red Dead Redemption , which probably hammered the game’s presence and sales, considering how successful Rockstar’s second foray into westerns became. However, Remedy was then a much smaller studio, and the market was full of all sorts of experimental games, so the franchise somehow survived through that ill-advised decision. Control Resonant will probably be a visual masterpiece, much like other Remedy games. I just fear for its market viability. Image via Remedy But it’s 2010 no more. Gaming consolidated, big names became giants. Releasing next to anything Rockstar today is paramount to financial suicide, and you simply do not do it. We see time and again big-time publishers push their games’ release dates away from intended windows precisely because Rockstar is also releasing GTA 6 within the same timeframe. Remedy thinks that’s no biggie, though, and says putting Control Resonant out around the same time as the biggest game of all time is “playing the long game.” As per Tech Radar, Remedy chief executive Jean-Charles Gaudechon said he thinks GTA 6 will “raise the tide” and bring a lot of new interest to consoles. However, from Remedy’s perspective, “it’s less about trying to make your money back in a few days” but more about playing the long game. GTA 6 will most likely be the best-selling video game of all time, and I expect it to dominate discourse for months. Image via Rockstar Games “You can expect quality from us. You can expect a voice that will cut through the noise,” he said, adding that folks should “expect us to be as loud as we can and hopefully pique people’s interest.” Hopefully, it is doing a lot of heavy lifting, I suppose. On social media, Remedy fans, who are many, argued that since GTA 6 is going to release only on consoles, then Control Resonant has free rein over PC. And that’s true, but only to an extent. The entire gaming world will only be talking about GTA 6 for months after launch, drowning out any voices that might be trying to get the word out. Social media, YouTube, streaming platforms—everyone will be obsessing over Rockstar’s titan, and I think no amount of platform freedom can help you in that environment. I hope Control Resonant finds the audience to hear its imaginative, unique voice, I truly do. I’ll be playing it, too, and probably enjoy it as much as I did the first game. But I can’t say it isn’t setting itself up for disaster by entering the most competitive release window of
